notes: The headline claim judges treatment success against the WHO 85% target without a CI or test, so the comparison scale is null. The only test (p<0.001) compares culture confirmation between symptomatic and screened patients and is ancillary. Sputum conversion is defined but no conversion results are reported.
view_issues: The methods say sputum conversion results are presented, but none are reported. The editorial cites higher success among chest-radiograph-diagnosed patients, but no figures for that group are reported.
